parsed.internal_thinking: Claude is offering 1 Wheat for 1 Wood. Looking at my resources, I have 2 Wood and 2 Wheat. I generate Wood from my settlement at 14 (3 and 4) and Wheat from 14 (8) and 41 (9). Claude is heavy on Wheat and Ore. While I don't strictly *need* more Wheat right now, Wood is relatively easy for me to get, and staying on Claude's good side while he and Gemma are bickering is strategically sound. However, I need to be careful about giving him the Wood he needs to build roads/settlements to further block the board. Since I'm competing with Gemma for space, and Claude has already blocked me once at node 25, I'll reject this to keep my resources for my own expansion toward node 23 or 34, especially since I already have enough Wheat.
